findings.title: Manual dosing reverts to automatic after the page reloads, with no cue that the change was temporary
findings.description: A safety-relevant setting, once confirmed, should still show its confirmed state when the grower or a colleague looks again, or the screen should say the change was not kept. After switching to manual the status reads 'Nutrient dosing is now manual: the pumps run only when you start them.' After a reload of the same page the switch is on again and the status reads 'Nutrient dosing is automatic: pumps A and B top up to EC 1.8.' Nothing on screen (no time of change, no saved or applied indication, no pump state) distinguishes a lasting change from a temporary one.
findings.impact: A volunteer about to drain the reservoir may believe the pumps are off while the shared tablet, after any reload, shows and may run automatic dosing; the pumps may then dose into an empty tank, and a grower who checks again cannot tell whether dosing ever stopped.

findings.title: Colour values are literals instead of roles: only page and ink are tokenised
findings.description: Colour should come from named role tokens so states and themes stay consistent. styles.css declares only --page and --ink; 33 of 35 colour declarations are hex or rgba literals, including literals that equal --ink (#1c2b22 at lines 34, 46, 93). Root cause: missing roles for surface (#ffffff x3), border (#d5ddd7 x2, #5f6b63 x3), muted text (#3b4a40 x3, #9aa0a6 x2), hover/pressed fills (#dfe7e1 x2, #cfdcd2, #eef2ef), accent (#2f6b3a x2 plus the chart stroke in index.html), shadow (rgba(28,43,34,.12) x2) and three status families (ok/warn/alarm chips and dots use six unrelated greens, ambers and reds).
findings.impact: Status colours for chips and dots are defined independently, so they may drift apart; forced-colours and contrast fixes have to be made in many places.

findings.title: Spacing values bypass any scale: 0 of 23 on the 4 px grid

findings.impact: Near-equal gaps (7, 9, 10 px) may read as unintended misalignment and make rhythm between panels inconsistent.
